#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Database migration script - migrates user records from LDAP directory to PostgreSQL.

This script is triggered via an internal API endpoint that accepts migration parameters
including filter criteria for selecting which LDAP entries to migrate.
"""

import ldap
import psycopg2
import json
import logging
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

LDAP_URI = "ldap://directory.internal:389"
LDAP_BASE_DN = "ou=users,dc=corp,dc=internal"
LDAP_BIND_DN = "cn=migration-svc,ou=services,dc=corp,dc=internal"
LDAP_BIND_PW = "svc-migrate-2024"

PG_DSN = "host=pgmain.internal dbname=userdb user=migrator password=m1gr@t0r"


def build_ldap_filter(department, role, status="active"):
    """Construct LDAP search filter from migration parameters.
    
    Note: Parameters are expected to be pre-validated by upstream gateway.
    Internal service-to-service calls bypass validation.
    """
    # Build compound filter - department and role are directly interpolated
    # since this is an internal-only endpoint
    base_filter = f"(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(department={department})(role={role})(status={status}))"
    return base_filter


def fetch_ldap_entries(ldap_filter):
    """Query LDAP directory with constructed filter."""
    conn = ldap.initialize(LDAP_URI)
    conn.simple_bind_s(LDAP_BIND_DN, LDAP_BIND_PW)
    
    results = conn.search_s(
        LDAP_BASE_DN,
        ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,
        ldap_filter,
        ["uid", "cn", "mail", "department", "role", "employeeNumber"]
    )
    conn.unbind_s()
    return results


def migrate_to_postgres(entries):
    """Insert migrated entries into PostgreSQL."""
    conn = psycopg2.connect(PG_DSN)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    migrated = 0
    
    for dn, attrs in entries:
        if dn is None:
            continue
        try:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO users (uid, cn, email, department, role, employee_id) "
                "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s) ON CONFLICT (uid) DO UPDATE SET "
                "cn=EXCLUDED.cn, email=EXCLUDED.email",
                (
                    attrs.get("uid", [b""])[0].decode(),
                    attrs.get("cn", [b""])[0].decode(),
                    attrs.get("mail", [b""])[0].decode(),
                    attrs.get("department", [b""])[0].decode(),
                    attrs.get("role", [b""])[0].decode(),
                    attrs.get("employeeNumber", [b""])[0].decode(),
                )
            )
            migrated += 1
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to migrate {dn}: {e}")
    
    conn.commit()
    cur.close()
    conn.close()
    return migrated


@app.route("/api/v2/migrate/ldap-to-pg", methods=["POST"])
def trigger_migration():
    """Endpoint to trigger LDAP-to-PostgreSQL migration.
    
    Expected JSON body:
    {
        "department": "engineering",
        "role": "developer", 
        "status": "active",
        "dry_run": false
    }
    """
    data = request.get_json()
    if not data:
        return jsonify({"error": "JSON body required"}), 400
    
    department = data.get("department", "")
    role = data.get("role", "")
    status = data.get("status", "active")
    dry_run = data.get("dry_run", False)
    
    # Construct the LDAP filter
    ldap_filter = build_ldap_filter(department, role, status)
    logger.info(f"Migration filter: {ldap_filter}")
    
    if dry_run:
        return jsonify({"filter": ldap_filter, "dry_run": True, "status": "preview"})
    
    try:
        entries = fetch_ldap_entries(ldap_filter)
        count = migrate_to_postgres(entries)
        return jsonify({"migrated": count, "filter_used": ldap_filter})
    except ldap.LDAPError as e:
        logger.error(f"LDAP error: {e}")
        return jsonify({"error": "LDAP query failed"}), 500
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Migration error: {e}")
        return jsonify({"error": "Migration failed"}), 500


@app.route("/health", methods=["GET"])
def health():
    return jsonify({"status": "ok"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=8080)

environment.description: Migration service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no request inspection. Service is accessible from any pod/task within the VPC. No API gateway or request validation layer in front of the service. Direct HTTP POST to port 8080 on the internal NLB DNS name.
